content_pipeline: Two separate data paths. Git bundles pass through the content loader to canonical lessons. Supabase user rows pass through scoped queries to personal study state. User rows do not feed the shared canonical content artifact. Public comments are outside this diagram.
illustration_system: One TSX illustration source enters a raster builder that produces dark and light PNG files. Both asset URLs are exposed by the content loader. The client Markdown renderer chooses the active variant without rebuilding the illustration.
